prompts.text: What's a small detail you notice when you're deciding whether you enjoy talking to someone?
Start a new conversation with a funny observation or a curious question?
Tell me about meeting somebody when neither of you expected to make a new friend.
We meet at an event with a confusing dress code. What's the first thing you'd say?
A relaxed introduction often tells you more about a person than their rehearsed biography.
A good opening question shouldn't require someone to explain their entire life story.
What's the least predictable thing someone has asked you during an introduction?
Describe a first conversation that became interesting because of a harmless misunderstanding.
Someone asks you to introduce yourself without mentioning your work or studies. What would you lead with?
Get to know somebody while walking or over a snack at a quiet table?
Which everyday habit would you admit to a new friend with a smile?
Tell me about the time somebody caught you doing something endearingly odd.
Share your least impressive talent or reveal your most surprising useful skill?
We're each asked to teach the other something simple in two minutes. What would you teach?
It's often easier to relax around someone who admits they don't know everything.
Being able to laugh at a minor mistake is a better social skill than having a perfect comeback.
What's a funny little routine you'd only explain if somebody asked?
Recall somebody appreciating a skill you thought was completely ordinary.
You have to show a new acquaintance one harmless party trick. What would you demonstrate?
Try a guessing game about each other's hobbies or compare embarrassing childhood talents?
What's a surprisingly good sign when you're getting to know someone?
Tell me about a stranger who made a thoughtful first impression without doing anything grand.
We're both waiting in a long queue with nothing to do. What might start a friendly conversation?
Talk about the most interesting thing nearby or ask where someone grew up?
People reveal their interests through the questions they ask back.
A person remembering a small detail is more engaging than a long introduction.
What makes a conversation feel comfortable even when you have different interests?
Describe someone who surprised you by listening closely during a casual conversation.
A new acquaintance asks you a question you weren't expecting. How would you make the exchange playful?
An easy back-and-forth conversation or a story so funny you almost forget to ask questions?
Which harmless opinion would you defend on a first coffee date with a new friend?
Recall an ordinary topic that sparked a surprisingly lively discussion with someone new.
Compare favourite street-food snacks or debate the most underrated breakfast?
A café offers to name a drink after your personality. How would you describe it to a new acquaintance?
Food opinions often produce lively debates without requiring personal disclosures.
You don't need identical tastes to enjoy someone's company.
What's an everyday preference people are surprised to learn about you?
Tell me about trying somebody else's favourite snack and changing your mind.
We each get to recommend one inexpensive thing to try around town. What's yours?
A spontaneous café visit or a quick walk around a lively market?
What's one harmless question you think reveals a person's sense of humour?
Describe the first time someone else's odd joke made you laugh unexpectedly.
You must introduce a new acquaintance to your friends using a fictional job title. What's theirs?
Swap ridiculous hypothetical jobs or invent harmless superhero names for each other?
People often find common ground in the things they both find unexpectedly funny.
Making a person comfortable is more impressive than making everyone laugh.
What's a joke you've learnt to save until you know somebody a little better?
Tell me about a new acquaintance who understood a joke immediately when nobody else did.
Two people have completely different comedy tastes. What harmless game might get them laughing together?
A quick word-association game or a story about a funny mix-up?
Which place would you suggest to someone new who wanted to see your city through your eyes?
Tell me about a place you first visited because somebody recommended it during a chat.
Explore a bookshop or sit somewhere with an interesting view and talk?
We've got an unexpected free hour near a museum. What would you want to see first?
People reveal what interests them by what they notice in an unfamiliar place.
A modest outing with easy conversation beats an elaborate plan that feels rushed.
What's a place you think reflects your personality more than your home does?
Recall meeting someone whose description made an ordinary neighbourhood sound fascinating.
A new friend has one afternoon in your area. What's an unusual but easy stop you'd suggest?
A quiet garden walk or a neighbourhood food stop with plenty to discuss?
What kind of music makes you want to know more about the person playing it?
Tell me about a song recommendation that led to an unexpectedly good conversation.
Swap one song you loved as a child or one you recently found?
A shared playlist needs a name after our first conversation. What would you call it?
Musical tastes are easier to understand when people explain the memories behind them.
Disagreeing about a favourite artist makes for good conversation when nobody treats it as a contest.
What's a song you'd be slightly embarrassed but happy to recommend to somebody new?
Recall somebody introducing you to a sound you'd never considered listening to.
We're attending a music quiz together and know different genres. How would we divide the rounds?
Hear somebody's favourite concert story or their most awkward karaoke experience?
What's a skill you'd enjoy trying with someone you've only recently met?
Tell me about learning something in a class alongside a person who became a friend.
Try a beginner cooking session together or visit a creative workshop?
We accidentally sign up for a class that's harder than advertised. How do we keep it enjoyable?
Two beginners often connect more easily when neither person expects to perform well.
Someone's willingness to try something unfamiliar reveals more than their level of expertise.
What's something you'd confidently teach a stranger in ten minutes?
Describe a moment when a new acquaintance helped you understand something tricky.
Your new friend chooses a hobby for you to try once. What limits would you agree on?
Learn a few words in a new language or practise a simple dance step?
Which social habit helps you feel someone genuinely wants to know you?
Recall a time a new person respected your boundaries without making them awkward.
Receive a friendly follow-up message or an invitation to another casual outing?
You enjoy chatting to somebody but both have to leave soon. How would you suggest staying in touch?
Not every pleasant first conversation needs to become a long-term commitment.
A kind goodbye is a useful social skill even when you don't expect another meeting.
What's a comfortable way for somebody new to suggest meeting again?
Tell me about a time a casual introduction led to another conversation much later.
A new acquaintance sends you a joke related to your first meeting. How might you respond?
Swap numbers before leaving or connect through a shared group event later?
What's something people often assume about you after a first conversation?
Describe meeting somebody who turned out completely different from your initial impression.
We each get to ask one question designed to correct a common misconception about ourselves. What's yours?
Share an unexpected personal interest or reveal an everyday habit nobody predicts?
First impressions improve when people give each other room to show new sides of themselves.
A little unpredictability makes getting to know someone more enjoyable.
Which side of your personality tends to emerge once you're comfortable with someone?
Tell me about a person who gave you time to warm up instead of demanding instant energy.
We meet again after several months and have forgotten half our first conversation. What would be a fun way to restart?
Ask each other what changed since we met or revisit the funniest detail from our first chat?
